purpose: Turn every benchmark into durable, inspectable evidence that can be compared over time and across capability domains.
regression_policy: A previously passing benchmark remains in the regression suite after improvement.
failure_policy: Preserve failed attempts and recovery strategies; never delete failures merely to improve aggregate scores.
integrity: Benchmark definitions, evaluator versions, inputs, outputs, and provenance must remain versioned so results can be reproduced.
goal: Make Buddy's progress measurable enough that developers and users can see exactly what improved, what did not, and what should be trained next.
